title: Future Juice Grape Candy  Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Future Juice’s Grape Candy delivers the bold, juicy taste of ripe Purple Grapes with a playful confectionery twist. The deep, natural sweetness of Grape is intensified with a sugary, candy-coated finish, striking a perfect balance between fruity richness and nostalgic sweetness. Each puff delivers a burst of vibrant flavour, making this an ideal choice for vapers who love a fruit-candy blend with a tangy edge. Blended at 70% VG / 30% PG, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, producing thick clouds and bold, full-bodied flavour. Ideal for high-powered vape kits and sub-ohm tanks, it offers a bright and satisfying vape experience. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, while nic salt shots offer a milder throat hit compared to freebase nicotine. Future Juice is a UK-based e-liquid manufacturer dedicated to crafting premium blends with bold, layered flavours. Their shortfill range combines classic dessert and fruit-inspired profiles, designed for vapers who enjoy rich, satisfying e-liquids.
